compute_episodic_stats: compute mean and max episodic statistics from reward metrics and done signals using JAX scan
compute_ued_scores: compute UED scores for a rollout batch across multiple agents and evaluation environments
compute_return: compute mean and max return scores from a rollout batch using episodic reward statistics
compute_l1_value_loss: compute the L1 value loss score from batch advantages using time-averaged episodic statistics
compute_value_disagreement: compute value disagreement scores by measuring standard deviation of values across the batch
